questions.prompt: Which of these are moons of Jupiter?
questions.fact: Jupiter has 95 known moons. Titan orbits Saturn, Phobos orbits Mars and Triton orbits Neptune.

questions.prompt: Which of these people were Roman emperors?
questions.fact: Hadrian's Wall took about six years to build across northern Britain, and much of it still stands.

questions.prompt: How tall is Mount Everest above sea level?
questions.fact: 8,849 m by the 2020 China and Nepal survey, and still rising by about 4 mm a year.

questions.prompt: How many players does a rugby union side have on the field?
questions.fact: Fifteen a side, eight forwards and seven backs. Rugby league plays thirteen.

questions.prompt: What is the hardest naturally occurring substance?
questions.hint: It is pure carbon, and so is one of the wrong answers.
questions.fact: Diamond and graphite are both pure carbon. The only difference is how the atoms are bonded together.

questions.prompt: Which planet spins on its side?
questions.hint: Each of its seasons lasts about 21 years.
questions.fact: Uranus is tilted 98 degrees, so each pole gets 42 years of sunlight followed by 42 years of dark.
